rawText: About the standard The baby walker standard sets out requirements that address the stability of baby walkers, their structural integrity, performance over steps and the provision of safety warnings. It applies to both new and second-hand baby walkers. More information Baby walkers – Commerce Commission Te Komihana Tauhokohoko (external link)
